name: Baggage
description: Baggage is an American dating game show hosted by Jerry Springer, which premiered in 2010 and ended in 2011. The show features three contestants carrying suitcases with embarrassing, unique, or weird propositions, representing their 'baggage'. The bigger the suitcase, the bigger the secret, and the contestant must admit to a fault.
